mentions.name: 3D Climbing Gym Visualization
mentions.description: A 3D model of a climbing gym used to visualize climbing details that normal climbing video can't show, such as wall angle and hip position. The plan is to overlay a human model, taken from climbing video, onto the 3D wall to make climbing visualization easier.
mentions.problem: A normal climbing video can't show details like wall angle and hip position.
mentions.source_excerpt: 3D model construction of climbing gym. There is so much detail a normal climbing video can't show. Wall angle, hip position. I'm hoping to overlay human model, taken from climbing video, onto the 3D wall to make climbing visualization easier.
